title: Lucas and Iris Save the World
original_title: Lucas and Iris Save the World
overview: Lucas and Iris are fourteen-year-old best friends grappling with the weight of adolescence in a fractured world. Lucas is plagued by nightmares of forest fires that spark his fear of coming environmental destruction. He enlists the more introverted Iris on a journey to confront environmental wrongdoers. What begins with small acts of sabotage in their Tennessee hometown escalates into a mission targeting a high-profile polluter in the northeast. Along the way, their path is shaped by the people they meet and the realities they face.
